newsitem.title: UK: Safeway sees higher value in BP shop venture. [CORRECTED 09:54 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Safeway sees higher value in BP shop venture. [CORRECTED 09:54 GMT]

text.p: Safeway expects its "food and fuel" joint venture stores with BP to have higher sales per square foot than its supermarkets but gross margins should be similar, communications director Kevin Hawkins said.
"The average of (sales per square foot) will be higher than in supermarkets...gross margins should be about the same," he told Reuters.
Safeway and BP announced on Friday that they would be spending 100 million stg in a joint venture to develop around 100 sites to sell food and petrol throughout the UK.
Hawkins said sales, including petrol, at existing Safeway supermarkets averaged just over 14 (corrects from "around 16") stg per square foot.
He said costs of the venture would be shared as well as profits.
He reckoned each site would need investment of around one million stg and said development should be hastened because the sites were already owned by BP.
"Assuming the test sites perform well and planning permission is gained, there should be a rapid rollout," he said.
Hawkins said the companies hoped to have most of the planned 100 stores up and running within a 2-3 year timescale.
He said the success of the new format would be judged on "customer reaction and sales, they are probably the acid test."
The stores will target a broad range of shoppers, including a quite significant number who will arrive on foot, Hawkins said.
"They are not just another type of convenience store...we aim to provide a solution to almost every meal in the day, not just top-up snacks," he said.
Safeway feels that there is a gap in the food retail market for such stores but will wait to see what customer reaction is, he added.
He said around 24 full-time employees would be needed at each site, of which some would come from existing staff.
"Clearly there will be a positive impact on jobs," he said, adding that over 2,000 (corrects from "around 1,000") jobs might be created from the whole project.
